span.p: fail

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
RSBI over 105
rapid + shallow

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
RSBI under 105
plus tolerating

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: no

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: no leak

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: leak present

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EVERY MORNING on the vent
screen for readiness - do not wait
for the lung to look perfect

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
READINESS SCREEN
cause improving? · P/F over 150
PEEP 8 or less · FiO2 0.5 or less
pH over 7.25 · no new pressors
adequate cough · intact drive

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Not yet. Fix the failing item.
Re-screen tomorrow.
Keep sedation light (RASS -2 to 0)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SAT - spontaneous AWAKENING trial
stop sedation
fail = agitation, RR over 35, SpO2 under 88%

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SBT - spontaneous BREATHING trial
PS 5-8 / PEEP 5, or T-piece
run 30-120 min

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
During the SBT:
RSBI = RR / Vt in litres

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FAIL - likely to need re-intubation
rest on full support 24 h
hunt the cause: load vs strength

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tolerated the full SBT?
no distress · RR under 35 · SpO2 over 90%
HR under 140 · no diaphoresis/paradox

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CUFF-LEAK TEST
if high risk for laryngeal edema
(long intubation, traumatic, large tube)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Give methylprednisolone
at least 4 h before extubation
then re-test

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: EXTUBATE

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Low risk: conventional O2
watch closely for 48 h

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Still failing at day 7-14?
discuss TRACHEOSTOMY
and goals of care
